name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Shows the detail-page eye in the theme accent color when the title is already in the Watchlist. Adds the Watchlist eye to season detail pages and maps seasons and episodes to their complete parent series. Removes obsolete catalog entries after the release cleanup.
